baselineCoverage.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

guards: Exact words/lemma/source sense/hash/table cell/features/context/literal only; global it-only and old14/16 handlers stay unchanged.
No humans/I/we/you/ustedes, commands, subjunctives, weather, SE, new spelling/alias or general plural rule.
Model-origin DESOVAR/RATONAR/CADUCAR do not get fabricated correction IDs; their existing model authorities remain separate from corrective policies.
GRILLAN selected Spanish cricket sense outdated tag and RIELAN English poetic/Spanish literary scope must remain visible. Unselected culinary/figurative/regional labels must not leak.
Spanish no-gloss or unresolved variant inventories are not claimed independent semantic confirmation; retained English lexical meanings/model and independent number/role review are the authority.
All original explicit holds remain held, including MÍAN separate-adapter proposal and prior16 words excluded from this tranche.
40 is an exact source-approval count, not integrated new coverage.
